subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Astrophysicist Dr. Kaori Inoue studies exoplanets.
• Exoplanets are planets that orbit stars outside our solar system and may harbor conditions suitable for life.
• Scientists have discovered over 5,000 exoplanets, including rocky planets, gas giants, and super-Earths.
• Kepler-452b is an exoplanet located in the habitable zone of its star.
• It is considered one of the most Earth-like planets ever discovered.
prompt: The student wants to introduce the scientist and her field of study to a new audience. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Astrophysicist Dr. Kaori Inoue studies exoplanets, planets that orbit stars outside our solar system and may harbor conditions suitable for life.
choices.B: Located in the habitable zone of its star, Kepler-452b is considered one of the most Earth-like planets ever discovered.
choices.C: With over 5,000 discovered planets orbiting distant stars, including rocky planets and gas giants, exoplanets are fascinating subjects that capture the attention of many scientists.
choices.D: As Dr. Kaori Inoue knows well, exoplanets are planets that orbit stars outside our solar system and may harbor life.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. We're asked to select the sentence that "introduce[s] the scientist and her field of study." This choice introduces scientist Dr. Kaori Inoue as an astrophysicist and explains what she studies.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. This choice doesn't mention Dr. Kaori Inoue, so it fails to "introduce the scientist."
